description: This is a PHP unit test class for testing the LeaveAPI in the OrangeHRM Leave Plugin. It contains test methods for API endpoints related to leave operations, primarily focusing on the 'getAll' method, while other methods are marked as not implemented.

classes.name: LeaveAPITest
